manageMembersText: See below all users in your community. Most account settings can be set by default from the community settings page or individually. Maximum Commitment and Maximum Accumulation need to be set individually after the account is created.
allowAnonymousMemberList: Allow external users to list community users
allowAnonymousMemberListHint: Allow users from any other community to see the list of names, avatars and account numbers of the users of this community. No emails or other personal information is shared.
minOffersHint: Minimum number of offers that a user must create during sign up.
minNeedsHint: Minimum number of wants that a user must create during sign up.
enableGroupEmailHint: Enable sending periodic newsletters with latest offers, wants and statistics to community users.
defaultGroupEmailFrequencyHint: Default frequency for sending community newsletters to new users. Users can change this setting in their account settings.
currencyValueHint: The value of your units in relation to the reference HOUR (one average hour of labour). It is used to calculate the conversion rate between your units and others. Use the notation n/d. Examples: if your unit is 1 hour of labour (time bank), set 1/1 — meaning 1 of your units equals 1 HOUR. If your unit is worth a fraction of an hour, set 1/10 — meaning 10 of your units equal 1 HOUR.
invalidCurrencyValue: Invalid unit value. Please use the notation n/d.
initialCreditHint: The maximum commitment that an account can have after signing up. Changing this value will not affect existing accounts.
creditLimitHint: The maximum commitment that this account can have.
maximumBalanceHint: The maximum accumulation that this account can have. Leave to 0 for unlimited.
initialMaximumBalanceHint: The maximum accumulation that an account can have after signing up. Changing this value will not affect existing accounts. Leave to 0 for unlimited.
hideBalanceHint: Hide the account community standing and limits from other users.
allowSimplePaymentsHint: Record trades by choosing the recipient from a list.
allowSimplePaymentRequestsHint: Request trades by choosing the source from a list.
allowQrPaymentsHint: Record trades by scanning a QR code.
allowQrPaymentRequestsHint: Receive trades by showing a QR code.
allowTagPaymentsHint: Record trades by showing a NFC tag.
allowTagPaymentRequestsHint: Receive trades by scanning a NFC tag.
enableAcceptPaymentsAfter2wHint: Automatically accept all pending trade requests after 2 weeks of inactivity.
enableOnPaymentCreditLimitHint: Increase the maximum commitment of the account after receiving a trade by the same quantity, up to a limit.
allowExternalPaymentsHint: Record and receive trades from accounts in other currencies.
allowExternalPaymentRequestsHint: Request and receive trade requests from accounts in other currencies.
externalPaymentsText: Define the settings for trades with accounts in other currencies. These settings apply to all accounts.
enableExternalPaymentsHint: Enable the Komunitin protocol to record and receive trades with accounts in other currencies.
enableExternalPaymentRequestsHint: Enable the Komunitin protocol to request and receive trade requests from accounts in other currencies.
enableCreditCommonsPaymentsHint: Enable the Credit Commons protocol to record and receive trades with accounts in other currencies. Not recommended for production use yet.
trustlinesText: Trustlines enable external trades by defining the maximum trade surplus between your community and a specific external community. It is the maximum amount the external community can owe to your community.
suspendAccountConfirmText: Are you sure you want to suspend this account? The account won't be able to make or receive trades until re-enabled by an admin.
groupStatusDisabledText: The community is disabled. Trades cannot be recorded.
disableGroupConfirmText: Disable the community {name} ({code})? This disables its active accounts and releases ledger resources. User statuses are preserved so active users’ accounts can be restored when you enable the community again.
enableGroupConfirmText: Enable the community {name} ({code})? This restores the community and trustlines and re-enables accounts belonging to active users.
